sources.title: GDPR Art. 9 — health data (special category)
sources.why: Explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a)) is the default lawful basis for processing health data in consumer mHealth apps.

sources.title: ePrivacy Art. 5(3) — access to terminal equipment (cookies, SDKs, trackers)
sources.why: Requires prior, freely given GDPR-standard consent before storing or reading any information on a user's device.

sources.title: Data monetisation / third-party sharing
sources.why: Mandates explicit, granular, purpose-specific consent for each sharing purpose, separate from consent to use the app.
